info.name: Test from the Head of Alcadno Society

descriptions.notStarted: A true union of alchemy and mechanical engineering, #bAlcadno, is a society that celebrates new alchemy#k. With the conflict raging in #m261000000#, however, Alcadno doesn't seem to accept others. I really want to join Alcadno, though... I better go talk to #b#p2111007##k.
descriptions.inProgress: #p2111007# told me in order to join the Alcadno Society, I'll have to compile a series of lab reports and present it.  He said he could obtain a legitimate report if I pay him #b2 ores, regardless of type#k. He'd then take care of the rest...
descriptions.completed: After giving #p2111007# 2 ores of jewels, he told me to wait.
